title: The Franck–Condon principle
caption: Electronic transitions happen so fast that the nuclei do not move: the transition is a vertical line on the energy diagram. Because the excited state's minimum lies at a longer bond length, the vertical line lands on a high point of the excited curve, so the molecule is left vibrating.
alt: Two potential curves: the ground state with a minimum at 1.0, and an excited state above it with a minimum displaced to 1.35; a vertical arrow from the ground minimum up to the excited curve.
description: Ground state: minimum at bond length 1.0.
Excited state: higher, with a longer bond (minimum at 1.35).
Vertical arrow at 1.0: lands well above the excited minimum.

checks.name: the excited state's minimum is displaced to a longer bond (1.35)
